title: MPortfolio
description: Production-grade stock portfolio management platform featuring real-time market data ingestion, dynamic multi-asset holdings tracking, unrealized/realized P&L calculations, and financial transaction journaling. Built with a responsive Angular architecture, custom high-performance data tables, and client-side sorting & fuzzy filtering.

title: NowLayer
description: A standalone Windows media overlay that keeps music controls and video Picture-in-Picture visible above borderless-windowed games and applications—with game-safe click-through input safety. Features live track/artist/artwork metadata from Windows media sessions, 16:9 video mirroring, and zero background bloat.

title: FormatLens
description: Technical browser extension that transforms dense, minified JSON payloads, API responses, and server logs into an interactive side-panel view without losing page context. Features expandable Tree view, syntax-highlighted Pretty view, Raw inspector, and instant search—executed 100% locally with zero cloud telemetry.

title: Transcript Capture for Teams
description: Browser extension to capture complete Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts and download them locally as structured, clean plain text files. Employs DOM mutation observers to verify every transcript chunk is captured without missing lines—operating completely on-device without sending meeting data to third-party servers.

title: Buff Discord Music Bot
description: Engineered a high-performance Discord audio streaming daemon with priority queue management, continuous loop modes, and fine-grained playback controls. Streamlined YouTube and Spotify ingest through FFmpeg-based transcoding for low-latency audio delivery. Fully containerized with Docker for reproducible deployment.

title: Microsoft Rewards Automation
description: Authored an autonomous browser automation utility using Selenium WebDriver to execute daily reward flows. Implemented jittered delays, anti-detection wait patterns, robust XPath fallbacks, and comprehensive execution logging to eliminate manual routine effort.

title: RP Server Development
description: Architected and deployed a persistent GTA V multiplayer roleplay server on RAGE MP. Engineered complex economic systems, real-time inventory synchronization, dynamic housing, and vehicle physics state machines with a relational database backend.

title: WEB-based Multiplayer Game
description: Engineered a low-latency real-time multiplayer browser game developed during an HCL Technologies internship. Implemented a full-duplex WebSocket architecture with Socket.io, lightweight tick synchronization loops, and responsive client input reconciliation.

title: Calendar Event Manager
description: Built a desktop productivity suite integrating directly with the Google Calendar API via OAuth 2.0. Features multi-calendar synchronization, conflict detection, responsive date pickers, and native modal feedback to streamline event scheduling.

title: Multiplayer Turtle Game
description: Created a local multi-user competitive desktop game utilizing Python's graphics subsystem. Designed a deterministic tick loop, 2D vector collision detection, dynamic boundary conditions, and simultaneous keyboard input mapping.

title: Medicine Reminder
description: Developed a Windows desktop application to automate healthcare dosage compliance with background daemon scheduling, persistent schedule catalogs, and native system tray notifications.
